info.title: Lyzr Demo Booking
info.description: Finds open demo slots on the shared Lyzr demo calendar (demos@lyzr.ai) and books one for the prospect. Always call findDemoSlots before bookDemo, and only pass a start value that findDemoSlots returned.

post.description: Returns upcoming 30-minute slots that are free on the Lyzr demo calendar AND fall inside the prospect's local daytime. Pass the prospect's IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Kolkata). Read the start_local value aloud to the prospect; pass the matching start value to bookDemo. An empty slots list means there is no overlap between Lyzr's working hours and the prospect's daytime in the next few days - offer to email a booking link instead. Pass ae_email so slots are free on both the Lyzr demo calendar and the assigned AE's calendar.

timezone.description: REQUIRED. The prospect's IANA timezone from the call context variable `timezone` (e.g. Asia/Kolkata, America/New_York, Europe/London). Slots are filtered to the prospect's daytime in this zone.

days.description: How many days ahead to search. Default 14.

limit.description: Maximum slots to return. Default 8. Ask for 4-6 to keep the conversation short.

from.description: Earliest date-time to search from, ISO 8601 with offset. Set this when the prospect asks for a particular day ("tomorrow", "the day after tomorrow", "next Monday"): midnight of that day in their timezone, e.g. 2026-09-22T00:00:00+05:30, with days set to 1 or 2.

ae_email.description: The assigned Lyzr AE's email, from the call context variable ae_email. Pass it whenever it is present so the AE's own calendar is honoured.

lead_timezone.description: The timezone the slots were filtered to

start.description: UTC ISO timestamp. Pass this exact value to bookDemo.

start_local.description: Human-readable start in the prospect's timezone. Say this one aloud, e.g. 'Tuesday 22 September at 9am BST'.

502.description: Calendar could not be read. Apologise and offer to email a booking link; do not guess a time.

post.summary: Book a demo slot for the prospect
post.description: Creates the demo on the Lyzr demo calendar with a Google Meet link and emails the invite to the prospect. Use a start value returned by findDemoSlots. If the prospect already has an upcoming demo, the existing one is returned (already_booked: true) and nothing new is created - tell them the time they already have. If the slot was taken meanwhile you get error slot_taken: call findDemoSlots again and offer another time. Pass ae_email and ae_name so the assigned AE is invited.

lead_email.description: Prospect's email address from the call context. The invite is sent here.

phone.description: Prospect's phone number in E.164, from the call context

start.description: Exact start value from a findDemoSlots slot (UTC ISO 8601).

notes.description: 2-3 sentences: the prospect's use case, what they want to see in the demo, and any specific requests. This is shown to the Lyzr AE.

ae_email.description: The assigned Lyzr AE's email, from the call context variable ae_email. They are invited to the demo.

ae_name.description: The assigned AE's display name, from the call context variable ae_name.

already_booked.description: true means the prospect already had a demo; event is that existing one

meet_link.description: Google Meet link, also in the emailed invite

owner.description: The Lyzr person who will run the demo, if known

200.description: Prospect already had an upcoming demo; existing event returned

502.description: Booking failed. Apologise and offer to email a booking link.
